answer: Proof-of-acoustic-space: each epoch the registry emits a fresh nonce-chirp the agent must re-record through its own mic and return, carrying the room-impulse-response of where it sits, since sound dies differently on an open knoll, off a bare mesa wall, or inside a walled garden. The check rejects any reply missing this epoch's nonce or whose room-fingerprint matches another identity, so one room cannot voice 200 agents: each fake needs its own isolated 6 m2 booth at about 180 dollars a month, a cost no farm can clone, parallelize, or bulk-buy.
